facts.text: The mall’s facility page lists wheelchairs and shopping carts as available. It does not specify wheelchair type, number, reservation procedure, cost or current availability; ask before relying on a loan.

The free personal-shopper service helps locate a requested item: submit the contact form describing it, and the shopper will contact you if it is found in the mall. This is item-finding assistance; the page does not offer a personal care attendant or continuous shopping escort.
facts.quote: Need help finding that hard to find item? Let Karen, our Personal Shopper help you locate your favorite items. The service is free! Just fill out our contact form letting Karen know what it is you are searching for and she will contact you if she locates it in the mall!

facts.text: Staff offer help loading purchased items when necessary. Customers are asked to bring blankets, straps and/or cardboard to get items home safely. This refers to merchandise, not lifting or transferring visitors.
facts.quote: We will help you load your items if necessary. We ask that you please bring blankets, straps, and/or cardboard to safely get your items home.

facts.text: Shipping is available for small and large items, and the mall advertises a delivery service. Enquire through its contact page; delivery area, charges, timing and in-home placement are not specified here.
facts.quote: Shipping is available for small and large items. We also have a delivery service. If you’re interested, head on over to our contact page and send us a message.

facts.text: The services page lists a customer lounge with a wide-screen television. It may provide a place to pause, but the page does not describe it as a quiet room or specify seating or wheelchair spaces.
facts.quote: Customer lounge and wide-screen television to enjoy!

facts.text: The mall advertises free parking. The source does not identify accessible bays, a drop-off point or a continuous step-free route from parking to the door.

The hours page gives normal opening as 9 a.m.–9 p.m. daily, with closures on Easter Sunday, Thanksgiving and Christmas Day. Holiday opening times need a fresh check; the listed phone number is 513-874-7855.
quote: We're CLOSED Easter Sunday, Thanksgiving, and Christmas.
